Jobber utilizes Stripe as their 3rd party processor, as if businesses couldn’t have their *own* Stripe account, but states 1-2 days for ACH processing (standard) but then has their support team making up their favorite 2 day range to cite to customers. 

Of course, Jobber can magically release *some* of the ACH funds on Day 2 but of course you have to pay a fee to have the funds released. 

In actuality, Jobber holds your funds for 7-10 days pushing small businesses to agonize enough to agree to pay to have *some* of their money. Mind you, paper checks still deposit folks. 

Sadly, Jobber is also functionally unbearably clunky. 

Their “support team” are forced to make it up as they go, no one with real accountability AND authority/ability to help. 

Contractors and small businesses: unless you can tolerate losing 5% percent of your bottom line to Robber, oops I mean, Jobber, and want to get paid slower than asking your customers to pay you in wheelbarrows full of loose change - AVOID JOBBER AT ALL COSTS!

For now I can do without the things I’d really like to have.  Jobber and it’s people are literally what I pay for. I own small service company and had been using paper invoices prior to thinking about implementing a software. I tried out HouseCall Pro, FieldEdge, and some other CRM softwares before finally deciding on Jobber as I found it to be the best of all other apps that I personally tested. Jobber has proved to be the easiest to learn , most efficient (no lagging, or disconnecting) , and most affordable software out there. I love the fact that their customer service is available to answer any questions , and most importantly the developers and team are constantly updating and adding/removing new features. I have been super happy using Jobber and so do our field workers who had no problem getting used to the software. Jobber saves us time, gives our company a feeling of being modern and hip, and keeps our customers up to date with reminders of upcoming appointments, text messages when we are on the way, and following up with them when the job is complete. Before using Jobber, everything was unorganized; to look up a history of the customer we had to dig through mountains of paperwork (sometimes invoice would be misplaced or lost) , our scheduling and dispatching was very inefficient and confusing, and we were doing so much extra unnecessary work because there was no software being implemented to run things smoothly and professionally as they should be.
I would highly recommend giving this a go. They offer a 30 day or 14 day free account so you can play around with the software and test it out.
Don’t be afraid to switch to a platform like Jobber. Get on with times and start improving your business and staying on top of your game.

The guys can’t figure out how to use it in the field even though we’ve showed them over and over again, and it’s next to impossible to accomplish anything as a manager for billing in the app. And if I want to schedule a visit for an existing job, why can’t I do it from the calendar? Why do I have to click on ten different things just to accomplish one task? This app needs streamlined and simplified. It also needs the option to do progress invoicing. Not a “deposit”, but actual progress invoicing for when each draw is completed. I will be looking for a different alternative for my scheduling needs.

My husband and I took over his dad’s plumbing company that was birthed 50 years ago. Since it’s birth, not much has changed as far as office work goes. We were still using paper invoices, sticky notes, text messages, and printed out papers. We stepped into a business with 3 employees (one of which was my husband) and an already great reputation due to his dad’s hard work and service to our community, but we knew when we took over that some changes needed to be made. So we started looking for ways to streamline our field service management (we now have 7 employees, not including my husband) and try to get rid of the paper invoices. I had a bunch of demos from other companies, loved a couple of the interfaces (but not their corresponding pricing) and then I found Jobber. From day 1 their program has been so easy to navigate. It is intuitive, user friendly, and a simple design that doesn’t overwhelm you with small, hard to find boxes or too much information all at once. I am a hands on learner so I signed up for the promo and got into it. I was assigned a lovely Product Coach named Émmilienne who has answered every question I’ve had and given me tips on how to learn the system better. She has been delightful to work with! At one point she was out sick, but one of her associates, Ronen, stepped in seemlessly to navigate my second round of questions and give me more tips on how to navigate a few hurdles I ran into. All in all, I am thrilled to be a Jobber customer and although I am not a salesman, I do like to tell people about things I truly love, Jobber falls in that category. It is user friendly, intuitive, customizable, has a great interface and excellent customer support team. Five stars fo sho!!! *****

We signed up with jobber and got their mid tier package. It took us months to get clients imported as we had over 1,000 and eventually had to pay someone separate. It was a hassle to get their team to do it for us as we were not their highest paying clients and just kept sending a video I had already watched. After finally getting clients in we experienced glitches in the software itself in both the app and browser version when trying to set up different forms inside of jobber as well as when the customer views them. 

After paying over $700 we canceled and requested a refund which has been even more of a hassle as they keep referring back to their no refund policy when we were not even able to use the software for our business at all. Still have yet to get our money back. I would NOT recommend this to anyone as they are not customer oriented and basically stole our money after spending hours of our own time trying to set this up without success. I would expect a business this size to care more about the customers they serve. 

I would recommend housecall pro as they will help you every step of the way even with client import and you don’t have to be the highest paying client. They also have more to offer with their pricing and gave us discounts our first 3 months ,including $25 for the first month, which is something jobber would not do.

I have had so much success using Jobber and the multitude of features. The scheduling has multiple ways to view your day, (i use the “list” view). I have gotten hundreds of Google reviews as a result of the invoice system. The in-app texting (available on the premium plan) separates my customers texting communication from my personal phone number. Getting paid through the app is a breeze and the customers truly appreciate the stress free process. Jobber partners with Wisetack to offer a fully integrated financing option for any service residential from small repairs at $500 all the way to substantial system upgrades at $25,000. So much good and I can’t mention it all in this review, but let me at least brag on the AI receptionist that is so reasonably priced that has helped schedule out a plethora of estimates, service calls, as well as maintenance appointments without me even having to pick up the phone. I have been through demos with other CRM providers and none of them even come close to the satisfaction that I find with Jobber. So grateful for this program, I would be lost without it..

Small  4 person Hvac company trying Jobber.  We canceled the service.  Would like to say the customer support team is great.  App is a little clunky, but simply laid out.  Working on the phone app vs online is NOT even close to the same.   However the pricing plan structure of the tiers ultimately made us cancel. Also Lack of real 1099 payroll.   Time cards doesn’t allow to change pay codes, for example I have techs that do service and install, with different pay codes.  All it does is track time.  No 1099 reporting.  No switching job titles.   Almost every Hvac company out there is sending estimates as multiple options, at least two, and Jobber forces you to upgrade to the “Grow” plan to get packages. The top tier plan.  This is a one time payment of $2,988 right out the gate, or $349mo.   Packages should be available on the “Connect plan”, with the ability to add/select items and pictures on the grow plan for an upgrade to those who want that.  Packages is a middle tier item. Need to make a more attractive monthly payment also, not everyone can just drop $3k to get a decent price.  Jobber was more attractive at $119mo & $199mo. Now it’s $169 and $349mo  I don’t want to know that my price is going up after 12 months either. No promo stuff.  Your already making thousands off the credit card processing fees, want to gouge me with an increasing subscription service too?  In a day with rising subscription costs, the last thing we want is more subscriptions.  Make the Connect plan more appealing, and lock in the rates. 

Our current software does all of these things at a fraction of the cost, so we are not seeing the value here, for Hvac companies at least should probably look elsewhere.

I’m somewhat new to Jobber, but so far I’m very pleased. I run a lawn care business in Virginia, and I have been able to systematize a lot of my methods through Jobber. Things like recurring jobs, the different calendar views, auto invoicing, the client hub, and the friendly and modern interface are awesome! I have looked at many different softwares to use, but Jobber seems to be the most innovative and cutting edge. I also really appreciate their customer service, when I have questions, I call or start a chat, and they’re quickly ready to help and answer my questions—plus I don’t have to push 37 buttons to get through to someone when I call! I definitely recommend Jobber for lawn care business owners who want to systematize, delegate, and organize their business. Lastly, I love that their team is constantly releasing new features. It’s already a great software, but I imagine within a couple years it will be all the better! Thanks Jobber for always having great customer service, providing a comprehensive system for lawn care businesses, and for constant innovating! 5 stars!!!

We love Jobber for logistics, organizing routes, setting up and keeping track of one-off and recurring jobs, materials, chemical services, etc, also the ability to upload pics and notes and to make changes to routes or job details without having to track down crews working on loud equipment. We don’t use the app for estimating, invoicing, or communicating with customers so we can’t speak to those features.  The reports are very basic and have a lot of room for improvement - hence 4 stars. When we download reports we have to heavily edit them in excel to be useful. That gets annoying bc of time required which no landscaper has to spare. The report shortcomings might really matter to a small company using Jobber for all it’s capabilities - which we’re not. Hopefully improvements are on the way in that area. The only GPS that syncs with Jobber is Fleetsharp/Linxup and Fleetsharp customer service is so bad that we switched back to Clearpath anyways. Therefore we lost that connection betw our trucks and Jobber. Hopefully they expand that also? Still highly recommend Jobber to any service business. It’s done a lot to improve our efficiency.

Before bringing on Jobber this year, we ran our lighting business off of Google Drive sheets and Quickbooks to stay organized with client information. It’s INSANE how much time we waisted going back and forth between 5 or 6 different spreadsheets to answer even the simplest questions. Now everything is streamlined for not just the backend admin team, but for our employees and clients as well. Think we’ve actually saved money by paying for Jobber since it’s made the entire process so much faster from Requests, to Quotes, to Jobs, to Invoicing… so much less waisted labor hours and frustration.

Our only frustration initially in the process was onboarding Jobber and having duplicate clients get created since we imported our client list from a CSV file and then synced with Quickbooks. Took a few weeks to find all the duplicates and get things cleaned up! Such a headache. But that wasn’t really Jobber’s fault, but more a mistake on our part with order of operations. Smooth sailing since then. Thanks y’all!

One thing that really sets jobber apart is their amazing customer support, you don’t get this with most companies as we have tried a few other service programs and they don’t even come close. 
You have the ability to set deposits on estimates and the customer can approve the quote and pay for the deposit so all you have left to do is to schedule. 
There’s really a lot to like about this software, we really only have run into a couple of things that could make it better,

Ability to have customers pay for partial payments on invoices using jobbers payment system. Right now it only allows you to pay for the invoice in full with one credit card, if a customer has a couple different cards you can’t use jobbers Payment system. 

Ability to see the city an estimate appointment is scheduled in when looking at the booking schedule, it shows up on jobs but not on estimates without clicking on it to bring up the info. This makes it harder to quickly book clients when on the phone with them. 

Wish it also sent a confirmation email to the customer when you book them so they can save it, it sends a reminder email but a confirmation email would make it easy for the customer to save the date ahead of time.

All and all this is a great software that we chose to use for our business above 3 others, primarily because they are just great to work with. Also updates come regularly and I’m sure the above items will get fixed in time.

We’ve only been using Jobber two weeks but we already love it. After trying countless free trials for countless management softwares, it only took me ten minutes of working in Jobber to know it was the software for us. 

Of course no software is perfect and Jobber is missing some things that would be super helpful to our business (i.e. more robust reporting or at least the ability to export all info to excel in one report so I can keep my own reporting database updated more easily, more calendar flexibility in the app specifically a weekly view, and a few various tweaks that would improve efficiency and functionality), but the great thing about Jobber is they’re always improving and updating and you can tell they review consumer feedback like mine and want to implement requested changes if possible. 

Jobber is definitely what we needed to streamline our operations and mitigate growing pains. For me at least there was almost no learning curve so the transition to Jobber was painless and I can’t wait to use it every day.

We’ve been using Jobber for 6 years or so now and it keeps getting better and easier to use. It’s very easy to book clients, send invoices via email or text, and set up the schedule. I love that customers can fill out a job request from our website and all the information goes directly into their profile and we don’t have to input any of the information manually! They are constantly working on new features to add and on top of that, they have the best customer service. They always respond in a timely matter, it’s easy to contact them and they truly care about your feedback and share it with the developers. I love all of the new features and changes they’ve made recently. As a longtime user of Jobber, I can see how much work and time is always being put towards improving it so that it can provide its users with the best service software that it can. I highly recommend using this software for your business. Thank you Jobber!

I’ve been running my detail business almost a year now and when it got to the 6 month mark, felt like I was falling behind. Jobber changed that! It has helped so much with scheduling, making invoices and overall having that professional experience. Clients look at me differently, which is a good thing because outshining competitors is a step closer to the goal. Invoices represent the time and proper care for a vehicle, it’s all shown to be described to them. These are few of the many features Jobber offers. Overall BIG thank you to Sica for helping me with this process. Without you, I’d still be stranded on line items and trying to figure out how to give schedules. So thank you for all the emails and consistent support, it means a lot. Thank you to the Jobber team for making a service that is easy and accessible to all, especially small business owners. This is an amazing service and can’t wait to grow with y’all 🚗✨

I own a residential and commercial cleaning business and I have just implemented Jobber into my company. I am extremely happy with the results. I scheduled demos with most softwares out there and moved forward with Jobber. My number one concern was finding a product that would also take the time to fully onboard and train as I integrated it into my business and jobber has NOT disappointed. Sica Saccone was my Product and Implementation Coach and bless her heart for being patient with me. We had 4 different trainings and she has taken the time to work with me diligently with an amazing attitude. I really can’t thank her enough. As for Jobber itself, it has been so helpful. You won’t find a “one-stop-shop” software but jobber covers so much and if they don’t, they can Integrate with other services such as mailchimp (for me). If you are like me and are nervous about moving forward with a software, you can’t go wrong with Jobber.

Jobber as a whole has been an excellent new edition to my plumbing company. The desktop/browser app is well developed, with Quickbooks integration for contacts, detailed options for project management, client info for multiple properties, job scheduling with the option to assign employees, as well as time sheets for payroll. If you're looking for a robust CRM for your contracting business, this is it. They provide excellent tech support if you have questions, as well as scheduled one-to-one training to teach  you specifics. All in all, I am very pleased with my purchase. Also, if you buy at the annual price, it can save you up to 30% off. My one irritation is that the mobile app is geared towards service techs and not mgmt/admin. The work around is to open the browser app instead of the mobile app, on your phone or tablet. So for this I'm taking off the 0.5 star. However, my training rep informed me that they're working to improve this in the future, so hopefully I can upgrade this to a full 5 stars. Excellent app for the price! Fully recommend!

There are some good features, but a list of things that need to be added for actual function for scheduling etc.

1) make app schedule have month view. , less stretched out looking week view. When adding customer, the pop up generic month, does not help, have the month view showing scheduled jobs pop up. Or ability to switch to a well formatted month view. 

2 make it where you can hit add quote to job. When you add a job, before a quote is approved or other quotes added for the prev scheduled job, you can’t add the quote to job. You have to delete the job and convert quote to job. 

3make color codes appear on app( a choice of color by city would be great)

4) add auto lunch break option to timer. 
5) make it integrate better with google calendar. Or create a widget to quickly view schedule from phone Home Screen. Most of us are working in the field using the app. The app is lacking a lot that is on pc view. 
6) add a way to close a job, that will not be invoiced. Many jobs, we don’t know additional work, second visit will be added. Many times the invoice will not be billed until next job. 
If this super needed features aren’t coming soon, please let us know so we can find something that works better , to be less work for scheduling.   At min we need to quickly see the whole month quickly when a customer calls, and have color coded areas to quickly see where someone can be added.

An incredibly easy software to use for our business. Jobber has helped us grow from 60+ customers by the end last year to over 200+ this year (and counting!)

-New customer input, quotes, invoices (single or batch), receipts, jobs, scheduling (one-off jobs or reoccurring), payments, reports—all in one place. (More features with upgraded plans) Send quotes/invoices via text! You can view when you sent a correspondence and when the client opens it, no more: “I never got it” excuse!

Customer service can not be beat. Have a simple question that you need help with now? Live chat, question answered, get back to work. They train you on how to use the program, they walk you through everything, it’s like talking to a friend every time you connect because they all care so much. 

There have been so many upgrades since I started using Jobber 6 months ago. I remember asking if they could change the way we input addresses because I would type in an address and it would auto fill one from another state; as a landscaping company, that’s obviously not what we need. Now, I type in an address and it’s hyper-local (with out of state options in the drop down) and it shows up on a map, too! They also implemented quote/invoice via text and it’s amazing. Clients are so hesitant to give out emails, some don’t even check them. With text, it gets sent as a text message, they click on it, opens the quote/invoice, and they can either approve the quote or pay the invoice on under a minute. Win/win. 

I couldn’t ask for a better company to be my service provider. From the software to the service, I’d wholeheartedly give more than 5 stars if I could!

I used to praise Jobber. I told everybody else in my industry about it and said it was the best field service app that I ever used. My only stipulation was it did not handle recurring billing very well, this was somewhat misrepresented to me when I was purchasing the software, but I figured it was a simple miscommunication. I explained to the sales rep that we are in Alarm Company and need to handle recurring billing and she told me Jobber could handle that. It turns out the recurring billing wants to be tied to a job every time. I’m sure that’s fine if you’re mowing lawns. But it doesn’t make much sense for you to receive a job completion Email after your alarm bill has been charged to your credit card. Their solution for this? Disable job completion emails. Well now I’m missing a major feature of the platform because these customers still have other types of jobs. I said no problem, help me do a payment data export through stripe (which jobber uses for payment processing) that way I could use a different tool only to handle my recurring billing. I was going to stay with jobber for everything else. They refused. They offered to make a feature suggestion. That is completely unacceptable. They’re holding my customers payment data hostage, and support is not replying when I asked them if I am the merchant of record or if they are the merchant of record.  If I have to recollect all my customers payment data I’m switching away from jobber entirely. 

Do yourself a favor and do not use this app, for any business that builds RMR, the easiest way to attrition is having to ask customers to update their payment method, then they suddenly remember they don’t want the service anymore. So thank you Jobber for a great reminder why you should vet all your sass apps and never EVER use a platform that does not allow you to bring your own payment processor.

Our window cleaning business is transitioning from Housecall Pro to Jobber. When we first logged in and started figuring out how to use it we were overwhelmed to be honest. There was a serious learning curve because we were trying to make Jobber work like what we were used to with Housecall Pro and there were just so many features that we worried we’d have a difficult time figuring it out. Ultimately we realized that we were overthinking things because Jobber’s work flow is seriously intuitive. One of the perks of working with this company is the awesome customer support. We had multiple calls with them, (including several super informative calls with Émilienne) where they answered every question we threw at them and were so helpful. We’re excited to see what we can do with this CRM and how it will help us grow.

We’ve been with jobber for almost a year and after 4 months of testing 5 apps that best suited our company, jobber ended up checking off 92% of what my company needed in an app. 11 months in and there are a few quirks that I would imagine to be a fairly simple add since the areas that seem to be lacking are 50% of the way there. Despite the few features we need it’s been a win for our company and clients. Extremely user friendly, pretty much a 10 year old could navigate the software in addition to our senior clients. It definitely helps minimize the time I spend on all the backend tasks and frees up time to do other work for my company. I hope in the future they can streamline some features that fall short and need some improvement. At the end of the day we are happy with the software and I’m happy that I chose jobber!

Although my title is dramatic, it is so true!  My husband and I run a small business that wasn’t so small anymore.  We were losing quotes and customer information, making our employees upset with lack of details and running ourselves ragged trying to keep up.  Enter Jobber and our lives and business run so much smoother.  The scheduling and reminders are amazing, quoting is now simple and easy, the sync with Quickbooks online is hugely time saving and so much more.  We impress our customers on a daily basis as ALL of their info is in one place and easy to access.  On top of this, the customer service is second to none.  Always responsive, knowledgeable, friendly and willing to take suggestions...I simply cannot imagine working with a different company or software.  Thank you Jobber for helping our business thrive!

First of all, Jobber customer service is second to none. When I subscribed to this service, Simon, one of many of their expert training reps, contacted me right away and set up training schedules so that I could hit the ground running. It didn’t take long to learn this app as it is very easy to learn and use.

My busy schedule allowed me to keep in constant contact with my customers when I needed to change appointments, schedule material deliveries, or email change orders on the spot so we all could be on the same page all the time.

I interviewed many scheduling/invoicing programs after having a small contractor business for 36 years.  We were working old school and doing repetitive work leaving room for error. Jobber has been a lifesaver for me as the one who coordinates 20+ complexes with hundreds of units at each. Jobber has centralized our whole business and everything is in one place now. I’ve even quit using my other invoicing program as Jobber literally does it all! The support is off the charts. Getting started was daunting but they walked me through every step of the way and continue to support me as needed. Every customer service rep has been knowledgeable, patient (which was especially important at first), and professional. My only regret...not doing this years ago!! Thanks Jobber for saving me so much time and making my life easier!

This review is for the iOS app, not the Jobber platform. I like the platform quite a lot, and use it to run multiple crews for my landscape business. But, the iOS app has crashed or frozen multiple times on me, while creating quotes and requests, losing my work and having to go to a browser to get them done. All of my software is up to date. The platform works better on Chrome or Safari. The functionality of the iOS app is pretty limited to basic functions of viewing jobs, and timers, but I can’t do much in the way of settings, and several times accessing the directions through maps has sent me and my crews to wrong locations. Lastly, the timer functions have been intermittently unresponsive to my crew in the field. They often can’t clock in or out if signal is low, they can’t view notes and instructions either, if the signal isn’t great.

A very Poorly Prpgrammed and Managed Platform That's Always Changing from one week to the next. Things startee off fine six months ago. However, when this faux CRM (cause it's not a CRM sustem as falsely advertised) is faced with dynamic or challenging client accounting issues or system bugs, you begin to discover that this is nothing more than an overrated and overpriced invoicing platform.  They call themselves making"improvements" by stealing their clients intellectual property/ideas and making updates constantly, so much so one cannot keep up with all the tweaking and tampering. The platform and programming isn't remotely intuitive and the team has zero common sense. Ad some point we found ourselves working for Jobber though paying a monthly subscription; spending so much time on the phone with the trying to resolve their constant failures and lack of CRM functionality. The accounting and Financial reporting feature is a farce - programmers with absolutely NO UNDERSTANDING OF BASIC BOOKKEEPING or business processes.

We started using Jobber as our company began to expand from a single owner-operator plumber (me) using sticky notes, scratch pads and google calendar to keep my affairs in order. It “worked” but not at all scaleable.
Jobber keeps my schedule, crew, invoicing and client communication under one roof and the ability to sync with my already-established QuickBooks made it seamless. As a built-in feature it keeps me prioritized with reminders and quick reference guides on the ongoing status of pending jobs and aged receivables.
My clients also love it because they can view their client hub to keep invoices organized on their end as well, and paying invoices online is as easy as it can get. 
Customer service is exceptional and always has my issues sorted out in a very timely and friendly manner.

After trying out some of the other software available on the market, we decided to choose Jobber due to its user friendly interface, features, and phenomena customer service. We appreciate the ability to easily schedule jobs, assign them to technicians, and to later create an invoice. The CRM system is also great, and we were able to import our existing customer base into Jobber seamlessly. I would highly recommend trying it out and taking advantage of the free trial. The main improvement I would like to see is a more robust app(vs the desktop version). The app is understandably more limited in functionalities, but I wish there were more customizable home page…and more flexibility to handle jobs that are put on hold or unscheduled.

Our company has searched a long time to find a CRM that fits our needs and we found it in Jobber! Easy sync to QuickBooks brought our entire customer base over in record time. So no more having to convert our customer list into an “acceptable” format and crossing every finger in hopes that it worked. Good Job - Jobber! We are satisfied!

Jobber has been great for our small lawncare company for the first year.  Very easy to set up and use.  We get compliments from our customers all the time about how they like the notifications like when we’re on our way text and job day reminders and how easy it is to pay.  We like how jobber keeps Track of our customers for us and sets schedules and we use the reports all the time. I literally have jobber’s phone number on my speed dial. They are always so helpful and they never get frustrated with me. I’m slowly starting to get this and the Jobber staff is always so helpful. Jobber is my organizational and logistical backbone for my handyman business. I use it for everything from lead creation, to quote and job building all the way to invoicing and revenue tracking. 

One thing I really really wish it had is the ability to import google calendars into the schedule view. I can export my jobber calendar to view in google maps which I use privately but I struggle when I have a dentist appointment for example. This is because since I am scheduling for work I am in jobber and my private events don’t show up in there but they should be considered blocking events. It’s not good enough to have my jobber calendar exported because I don’t schedule jobs in other apps so I don’t want them to only be there.

I have a constant notification bubble with 1 in it but cannot for the life of me find any notification. It goes away if I toggle the bubble notifications off, but ultimately I want it on to know when I have a new message or actual notification. Worse yet is it doesn’t not increase when I DO get a message or notification…so I am currently missing messages and not seeing them as soon as I could which is a huge problem. 

My other big issue is that, as far as I can see, there is no way to access quote templates when creating a quote from within the app. That is the main point of the templates in my opinion as it’s way faster to create a quote on the computer than the phone, plus being out in the field is when I need quote creation to be a few simple clicks as intended with the templates.

This was the absolute worst business decision we could have possibly made using this app and syncing it with Quickbooks. The app automated somehow a TON of duplicate invalid invoices but with their own invoice numbers so QuickBooks didn’t catch it. The mess that the app created in our QuickBooks account was enough that it nearly put us under. Every customer account we had was upset and refusing to pay us for services rendered at all due to this phantom billing which made our business look unethical. Not only that, but because we are a small business and dont have the time to sit behind the computer every day for weeks to research and fix the issues it created we lost more money not being able to be out in the field working. The app was supposed to free us up and help cut down on paper work and that is the exact opposite of what it did

I can ask a question and within minutes, someone pops up on my screen to help! It’s wonderful!

Jobber is amazing! They make my life so easy! Sending invoices only takes a couple of seconds and I get paid by clients almost immediately after sending invoices through jobber. If I have a question they respond in a snap! They are constantly adding new exciting features to make my life even easier.
